release_notes:
• Checking for updates is reliable now: the app always asks GitHub for the very latest release, so a new version can no longer hide behind GitHub's five-minute file cache
• Scrubbing prefetches the spot you are dragging to while your finger is down — the seek lands on bytes already on the device instead of opening a connection after you let go
• The decoded audio window is 10 MB (about 30 seconds), so seeks within half a minute are instant, engine-native moves with no network at all
• A slow-but-alive seek waits for its bytes instead of falling back to a full download
